themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to advocate for policies that prioritize native citizens over immigrants in areas like housing, welfare, and employment. This theme has intensified with recent coalition agreements and policy proposals in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, reflecting a broader transnational trend.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox secured control over migrant child welfare in three regions, emphasizing 'national priority' in access to services like elderly homes.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia push for stricter immigration controls and 'national preference' in social policies, particularly in coalition negotiations.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocated for stricter housing policies to prioritize Swedish citizens, influencing national housing debates.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticized EU migration policies and proposed national preference laws in welfare and employment.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Campaigns on restricting immigration and prioritizing British citizens in public services and housing.

themes.title: Far-right gains in European local elections
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Germany, Italy, and Spain have made significant electoral gains in recent local and regional elections, often forcing mainstream parties into coalition negotiations. This trend reflects a broader shift in European politics, where far-right movements are increasingly shaping policy agendas.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega and Fratelli d'Italia secure key local government positions, influencing immigration and economic policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Leads regional polls in Blekinge and influences national housing and migration policies.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Wins by-elections in Barrow and Makerfield, pressuring Labour and Conservatives on immigration.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right movements in the U.S., Europe, and Latin America are increasingly framing Middle East conflicts through the lens of immigration, national security, and cultural identity. This theme reflects a broader trend of using geopolitical tensions to justify restrictive immigration policies and anti-Islam rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and allies like Hegseth frame Middle East conflicts as threats to U.S. security, justifying stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei aligns with U.S. and Israel on Middle East policy, using it to justify domestic security measures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini frame Middle East conflicts as immigration threats, advocating for stricter border controls.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS links Middle East tensions to EU migration policies, advocating for stricter controls and national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Criticizes EU and French policies on Middle East conflicts, framing them as threats to national identity and security.
